title: ZPA Private Service Edge Release Summary (2025)

blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements released per Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) Private Service Edge version.

An update was released to resolve an issue where Private Service Edges failed to reconnect to the public cloud following a Business Continuity event (until a manual process restart was performed). This issue was only seen when the Private Cloud Controller was running a lower software version than the ZPA Private Service Edge.

Your ZPA Private Service Edge will be updated based on your software update schedule as configured per ZPA Private Service Edge group. To learn more, see Understanding ZPA Private Service Edge Software Upgrades.
To learn more, see Manager Software Updates.
This ZPA Private Service Edge version includes the following updates for Business Continuity:

blocks.item: Enhanced support for Microtenants and Business Continuity.
Private Cloud Controllers redirect users to the closest Private Service Edge regardless of the Private Cloud.
